QUOTE: Bits in `0xFF80` are the high-level module, and bits in `~0xFF80` are the low-level code. ... If both parts are present, they are joined as `"HIGH : LOW"`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explains the two-layer split (high-level module and low-level code) and states that mbedtls_strerror joins both as "HIGH : LOW" when both are present.
